_metadata.description: Requirements that widen the runtime after launch: discovery, typed inference, delegation, sandbox composition, session limits, and the program corpus.

requirements.title: In-kernel capability discovery
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD expose capability discovery as an in-kernel call so a program resolves an operation by intent without the callable surface being preloaded into the submitting agent's context.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/discovery_test.go::TestResolvesOperationByIntent` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-001]). An intent string resolves to candidate bindings through search-hub without preloading the surface.

Target `api/internal/bindings/discovery_test.go::TestDegradesWhenSearchHubUnavailable` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-001]). An unreachable search-hub degrades to a stated reason; direct binding calls keep working.

requirements.title: Typed inference bindings
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD expose classify, extract, and judge operations resolved through ai-gateway, so a program performs bounded typed inference without spawning a delegated agent run.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/programs/inference_test.go::TestClassifyExtractJudgeRouteToAIGateway` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-002]). Typed inference resolves through ai-gateway, never through a direct provider client or agent-manager.

Target `api/internal/programs/inference_test.go::TestLocalSchemaValidationIsAuthority` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-002]). Provider extraction is advisory; a candidate failing local schema validation is refused, not returned.

requirements.title: Delegated agent runs from a program
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD let a program spawn an agent-manager run and collect its evidence, so unbounded agentic work stays distinguishable from bounded inference.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/programs/delegation_test.go::TestSpawnsAgentManagerRunAndCollectsEvidence` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-003]). A program spawns a real run and collects its evidence, keeping unbounded agentic work distinct from bounded inference.

requirements.title: Sandbox composition
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD bind a session to a workspace-sandbox workspace so filesystem effects are isolated and reviewable.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/sessions/sandbox_test.go::TestSessionBindsToSandboxWorkspace` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-004]). A session bound to a workspace-sandbox workspace confines filesystem effects to that workspace.

requirements.title: Bounded session lifecycle
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD enforce idle reclamation and wall-clock and memory ceilings per session, and SHOULD report the reason when it reclaims a session.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/sessions/limits_test.go::TestReclaimsIdleSessionWithStatedReason` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-005]). An idle session past its ceiling is reclaimed and the reclamation reason is readable afterward.

Target `api/internal/sessions/limits_test.go::TestEnforcesWallClockAndMemoryCeilings` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-005]). Wall-clock and memory ceilings terminate a session deterministically rather than degrading the host.

requirements.title: Queryable program corpus
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD retain submitted program source and failure detail as a queryable corpus so recurring failure shapes are derivable mechanically.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/programs/corpus_test.go::TestRetainsProgramSourceAndFailureDetail` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-006]). Submitted source and failure detail are retained and queryable after the session ends.

Target `api/internal/programs/corpus_test.go::TestRecurringFailureShapesAreDerivable` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-006]). Repeated failures sharing a shape are countable mechanically, without an inference call.

requirements.title: Binding registry inspection surface
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD provide an operator surface that browses the resolved callable namespace and, for every fleet capability that is unbound, states which of the declared unbound reasons applies.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/unbound_test.go::TestEveryUnboundCapabilityCarriesAReason` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-007]). No capability is reported unbound without one of the closed set of unbound reasons; an unclassifiable capability is reported as such rather than omitted.

Target `ui/src/features/bindings/BindingRegistry.test.tsx::rendersBoundAndUnboundWithReasons` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-007]). The surface renders with an empty program corpus, proving it carries information before any program has run.

requirements.title: Program provenance
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD record whether a program was submitted by an agent or by a human operator, and SHOULD exclude operator-submitted programs from corpus mining by default.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/programs/provenance_test.go::TestSubmissionRecordsProvenance` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-008]). Every submission carries an agent or operator provenance; neither is inferred silently.

Target `api/internal/programs/provenance_test.go::TestMiningExcludesOperatorProgramsByDefault` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-008]). A corpus query for recurring shapes omits operator-submitted programs unless they are explicitly included.
